about: The falsifier: the fold read the at a line answers for as part of what it claims, so two readers of one field at two ats were two claims no order compares. spec/vectors/fold.txt block 1, 0..320 at a:1 and 0..255 at b:1 on order/ref, left both lines standing and named a fork, where the meet is 0..255 alone. The same held for the open end signed twice by one source, the commutative pair on tag/slug and the two readers of pipe/name: four forks the spec names as none, and four scopes on which bound and the second head disagreed.
